title: Saññā
text: 1 Sāvatthi || || 2 Taṃ kim maññasi Rāhula || || Rūpasaññā niccā vā aniccā vāti || || Aniccā bhante || || 3-7 Saddasaññā || Gandhasaññā || Rasasaññā || Poṭṭhabbasaññā || Dhammasaññā niccā vā aniccā vāti || || Aniccā bhante || || 8-9 Evam passaṃ Rāhula sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasaññāya pi nibbindati || saddasaññāya pi || gandhasaññāya pi || rasasaññāya pi || poṭṭhabbasaññāya pi || dhammasaññāya pi nibbindati || pe|| pajānātīti || || Chaṭṭhaṃ || ||
